label: Follows etiquette by consumption, duplicate-nixpkgs detection, lock freshness and updates
brief:
Decide follows etiquette by how an input is consumed, the duplicate-nixpkgs check, and the lock freshness and update policy.
Settled upstream, cite and do not re-derive: skeleton A is lib.genAttrs over a literal list on nixpkgs.legacyPackages with 2 lock nodes, skeleton B has zero
inputs (NIX-FLK-08, -10, -11 in nix-flakes.md); map Q1 in its .nodes form is correct for flake.lock (2 without follows, 1 with; nix-flakes.md conflict 3);
flake-checker is an advisory --fail-mode step with stderr classification, and 0.2.15 accepts only 26.05 and unstable branches (NIX-GATE-11 in nix-gates.md).
Rows: M-B-01..06, M-B-12, M-B-14 (nix-topic-map.md); conflict 3 is the direction to confirm or overturn; conflict 21 left the flake-checker CEL condition to you.
Fetch: fzakaria.com/2026/08/31/how-safe-is-follows; zimbatm.com/notes/1000-instances-of-nixpkgs; nix3-flake (follows, lock version 7), nix3-flake-update and
nix3-flake-lock for 2.35; NixOS/nix issues 5393, 6036, 8325, 14339; discourse.nixos.org/t/71174; DeterminateSystems/update-flake-lock and flake-checker
READMEs (CEL); cachix/nixpkgs-python README; nix-community/fenix@5f7e7d793cb2 .github/workflows/ci.yml (its override-input nixpkgs-unstable leg).
Test against: cachix/devenv@6d76db3889de; DeterminateSystems/nix-installer@76f61b5202e2; numtide/llm-agents.nix@efb10f28f724; numtide/blueprint@8be75245e274.
Plant in fixtures/follows-and-lock-hygiene/: a consumer of three nixpkgs-carrying inputs with and without follows (Q1 count, eval CPU with --no-eval-cache,
nix build --dry-run substitution of an input's package); a self-follow; a removed follows line (does the lock restore the dependency's pin, issue 14339?);
nix flake update NAME versus nix flake lock after editing a follows; an input shaped like the generated flake (a fetchurl FOD plus a wrapper) followed and
not followed, to confirm nix-generated-flakes.md's claim that only the wrapper rebuilds; a lib-only B flake with nixpkgs-lib versus no input (M-B-03).
Decide: follows per consumed-as (package from the author's cache, library, module, overlay, generated flake); Q1's exit contract; the branch to track; the
freshness bar and its CEL condition; the update workflow (action or cron, PR or push, cadence); whether fenix's unstable override leg is SHOULD or CONSIDER.
Env: Nix only via /home/mherwig/.cache/research-lang/nix-tools/run.sh (CppNix 2.35.2, nixpkgs 26.11pre 8d5d2709, nixfmt 1.5.0, nixfmt-tree 2.6.0, deadnix
1.3.2, statix, nixf-diagnose 0.1.4, flake-checker 0.2.15, nixd, nil, nix-update, nurl, treefmt, skopeo, jq; Lix via nix shell nixpkgs#lix; the floor via
nixpkgs#nixVersions.nix_2_31), each call under timeout 300. run.sh enters the store through bwrap with SQLite WAL on; parallel dives are fine. If timeout 60
run.sh nix --version fails, write ENVIRONMENT FAULT as the artifact's first line and stop Nix work; never record a verification as blocked by contention.
State for every --no-build or fetcher result whether the store was cold or warm; rebuild FODs with --rebuild. Fixtures under the fixtures root above (never
/tmp), git init -q and git add -A before eval; exemplars read-only under ~/.cache/research-lang/exemplars/nix/ (SHAs in nix-fetch.log); pipe grep/find through
rtk proxy. Every check runs verbatim (directory operand, one -e per alternative, xargs -r, no placeholders), goes red on the bad twin and green on the good,
and states what empty output means and the versions it was measured on.

brief:

buildPackage over craneLib.cleanCargoSource ./. with and without explicit cargoToml and cargoLock; buildPythonPackage with pyproject = true; uv2nix if tried.

brief:
